family: The single total certificate-prefix language specified in proof.md. For actual length N, choose k as the least prime at least the least positive B with B^5>32*N^3; read k input bits as the lower coefficients of a monic degree-k polynomial Q over F_2, reject invalid Q by the exact Frobenius/gcd test, and evaluate the descending-power BK symmetric polynomial on the remaining N-k bits with zero padding, r=ceil((N-k)/k), t=ceil(sqrt(r)). Output 0 for N=0 or the explicit failed guards in proof.md. The output is the constant coefficient in F_2[Z]/Q. All k prefix bits are included in N; Q is input, not advice.
theorem: This fixed total language is in P, hence in NP with empty witnesses. In the full pinned B2 model, for every integer N>=2^20, C_B2(F_N)>=4N-R(N), where R(N)=4k+9(floor(kr/t)+kt+r(r+1)+2)<=42*N^(4/5), with k,r,t exactly as defined by the evaluator in proof.md. For every real epsilon>0, N_epsilon=max(2^20,ceil((42/epsilon)^5)) suffices for C_B2(F_N)>=(4-epsilon)N at every integer N>=N_epsilon. Thus liminf over all integer N of C_B2(F_N)/N is at least 4.
